goal: Read docs/agent-work/living-bird-rive-spec.md and perform the next safe R&D slice for the Kolibri living bird. The bird is a product state indicator, not decoration. If the Rive asset is absent, do not fake Rive completion: implement or specify the LivingKolibri contract/controller/SVG fallback path, preserve the current SVG components, keep no code path dependent on Rive being present, and produce a Rive handoff/QA matrix for the asset team. Feature flags must include livingKolibriRive for Rive and keep Pixi behind a separate experimental flag if mentioned. Respect reduced motion, accessibility, performance budgets and no customer data in animation assets.
role_goal: turn the living bird specification into an incremental Rive/SVG-compatible product character path

must_cover: SVG fallback coverage for every canonical state
reduced motion, visibility pause and performance budgets
non_goals: multiple canvas instances in message lists

acceptance: Current SVG bird/avatar path remains a production fallback and covers every canonical state or maps safely to idle
Rive integration is gated behind livingKolibriRive and load/error fallback cannot break the UI
